description: This file is a shell script designed to test various functionalities of the bloom.sh testing library and the command-line tool 'test-tool' related to Bloom filter computations. It includes tests for hashing functions, filter generation, and integration with git commits.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: A function used to define a test case expecting success, which runs the provided commands and verifies their success.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: A function to compare expected and actual output files, asserting their equivalence.

methods.name: test_seq
methods.description: A function generating a sequence of numbers used in loop constructs to simulate multiple test inputs.
